title: Offline production packaging, deployment, compatibility, upgrade, rollback, and release automation
invariants: Package provenance, compatibility, and every transition are bound to exact supplied digests.
Deployment and release automation are bounded plans and never execute offline.
Upgrade interruption requires checkpoint recovery and rollback targets the exact prior artifact.
Missing, stale, crossed, replayed, or privacy-bearing observations fail closed.
follow_up: Coordinator remains authoritative for task identity, revisions, leases, and durable state.
AWQ remains authoritative for requirements, gates, and evidence acceptance.
A passing fixture is structural evidence only; it does not prove a live package, host, deployment, upgrade, rollback, publication, or remote success.
